Taxes Committee
Thursday, April 18th, 2024
08:30 AM, G-15 Capitol

Minutes

<psernnunanamansinanannnnanaansanasnanescmaanatinntienintananancemimnminniscmeeana CRITE LTT LC NNLENNL LCCC CCN TCT CLIC

Present: Senator Ann H. Rest - Chair, Senator Matt D. Klein - Vice Chair, Senator Bill
Weber, Senator D. Scott Dibble, Senator Steve Drazkowski, Senator Grant Hauschild,
Senator Jeremy R. Miller, Senator Carla J. Nelson, Senator Aric Putnam

Excused: Senator Kari Dziedzic

Senator Klein called the meeting to order at 8:33 a.m.

Adoption of the minutes from 4/17/24.

The minutes were approved as presented.

S.F. 4431: Senator Westlin: Political contribution refund claims online system
establishment, campaign finance and Public Disclosure Board electronic transfer of
information allowance amendment to the political contribution refund program, and
appropriations.

Senator Rest presented SF 4431.

Upon Senator Westlin’s arrival the gavel passed to Senator Rest.

Senator Klein moved the A-12 amendment. The motion prevailed and the amendment was
adopted.

Senator Klein moved the A-13 amendment. The motion prevailed and the amendment was
adopted.

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 4431, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 5325: Senator Gruenhagen: Stewart 2023 local government aid penalty forgiveness
authorization.

Testifier:
Nathan Jesson, League of Minnesota Cities

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 5325 be laid over.

S.F. 5334: Senator Putnam: Telecommunications or pay television services machinery and
equipment sales and use tax exemption modification.

Testifiers:

Sarah Psick, CTIA

Scott Mackey, CTIA

Brent Christensen, President/CEO, Minnesota Telecom Alliance

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 5334 be laid over.

S.F. 4007: Senator Hauschild: Study requirement on property tax refund reforms.

Senator Hauschild moved an oral amendment on line 1.6 strike "January 15, 2025" and insert
"February 1, 2025". The motion prevailed and the amendment was adopted.

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 4007 be laid over.
